invariants.rationale: execute methods usually return non-null metadata on successful execution.
The returned HoodieWriteMetadata should always contain a non-null list of WriteStatus objects.
getWriteStatuses is expected to return a List, as per the method's generic signature.
Every WriteStatus object in the returned list should be non-null to ensure data integrity.
The returned object should always be an instance of HoodieWriteMetadata per method's declared return type.
